content.title: Olde Town Alley Power Line Undergrounding
content.summary: The City of Arvada and Arvada Urban Renewal Authority are collaborating with Xcel Energy to underground power lines in the alley between Yukon Street and Olde Wadsworth Boulevard, starting in March 2026 and lasting approximately 16 to 18 weeks. The project aims to enhance service reliability, cleanliness, and emergency access, with significant traffic disruptions expected, including alley closures and lane restrictions on Ralston and Grandview. Businesses will receive advance notice of short-term electricity shut-offs, and alternative arrangements for deliveries and waste disposal will be provided during construction.
content.body:
## Overview

The City and Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA) are partnering with Xcel Energy to move the power lines underground in the alley between Yukon Street and Olde Wadsworth Boulevard. This effort will improve:

- Xcel service reliability
- Alley cleanliness
- Access for emergency services

## Timelinemap of construction zone from Ralston through alley between Yukon and Olde Wadsworth to Grandview

\*Updated 3/13/26

Construction is expected to begin in **March 2026, as soon as 3/23****.** Work is expected to take**16 to 18 weeks** to complete. 

Work will move in segments, approximately 40 feet at a time. **When work is in the alley, the entire block will be closed**to all vehicle and pedestrian traffic. 

- Both alley sections, from Ralston to 57th and from 57th to Grandview, will take **approximately 8 weeks.**

## What to Expect

- **Work hours** 7am to 5pm, Monday through Friday
  - 8:30 am to 3:30 pm on Ralston Road
- Segmented **alley closures,**one block at a time
  - **No vehicle or pedestrian traffic** in closed alley segments
- **Lane closures**on Ralston and Grandview for 2-3 weeks each when these segments are under construction
  - Flaggers and alternating one-way traffic as needed
- Additional construction noise and traffic
- Short-term electricity shut-offs to connect the new lines (approx. 4 hours)
  - Businesses will be notified in advance
- **Alley repaving** after work is complete
- Construction staging area in the south parking lot at Arvada K-8

## Other business operations need to knows

### Dumpstersmap of dumpster and delivery drop-off locations on 57th Ave in Olde Town

If you have a dumpster in the alley, a communal**dumpster will be set up at the northeast side of 57th and Yukon**during construction in some of the current parking spaces along 57th Avenue.

### Deliveries

Several parking spaces at the **southeast side of 57th and Yukon will be signed as a delivery only**loading zone during construction. Due to the alley closure, we request that all **deliveries be made through businesses’ front entrance**s during the project. Please share this information with delivery drivers.

### Customer access

If you have customers who access your business from the alley, we can provide **wayfinding signage** based on your individual business needs.

### Grease disposal

If you have a grease disposal container, please utilize the **grease disposal container at the Elks Lodge** during the duration of the project.

## Contact

Please reach out to the Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA) at 720-898-7060.
